block.guhs.verhuisdoos.lore: 'Fragile: guh'. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
block.guhs.schoenendoos.lore: The shoes are gone, the guh is in. Right-click in the evening: tuck your guh in.
block.guhs.pizzadoos.lore: Still warm and it smells of cheese. Which guh could ever say no to that?
item.guhs.zeepje.lore: Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of the Cloud Bath.
item.guhs.sterlampje.lore: Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of the Star Cushion Field.
item.guhs.fotootje.lore: An old little photo of a family day. Give it along when you tuck your guh in: you dream of Memory Island.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.0: Mail for you? Njeg... only a dream. I deliver those for free.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.1: One mailbox per island. But only to islands you've been to, otherwise I don't know your address!
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.2: Stamps? Here you pay with yawns. I've had three already today.
gui.guhs.droomspul.postguh.3: Yesterday I delivered a hug. It was a bit squashed, but still very sweet.
